items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.summary: The article explores using sensorimotor alignment as an inexpensive offline proxy to gauge robotic foundation model performance, linking vision, language, and motion representations.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers a cheaper, scalable way to assess and improve embodied AI systems.

items.title: Direct Pass@k Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
items.summary: The paper introduces Direct Pass@k optimization, pruning reasoning candidates early to balance solution quality and computational cost during test-time inference.
items.whyItMatters: It enables faster, resource‑efficient reasoning models without sacrificing accuracy, appealing to developers deploying large language models.

items.title: Phase Transition from Random Features to Fully Trainable Networks
items.summary: The paper studies how neural networks transition from using fixed random features to fully trainable representations, showing a phase change in approximation accuracy and training error.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding this transition helps optimize network design and training efficiency for scientific computing tasks.

items.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
items.summary: The article discusses online monitoring of AI decisions with confidence scores, using separate agents for decision-making and verification to ensure reliability.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers a practical framework for trustworthy AI deployment and auditability.

items.title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
items.summary: SpectralCanary introduces a simple low-frequency trace method to embed a detectable signal in image datasets, enabling later auditing of T2I models for dataset usage.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers a lightweight, reliable way to verify model provenance and prevent unauthorized dataset use.

items.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
items.summary: The article explores cost-aware abstention for routing IT support tickets, evaluating policies on a large public dataset.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it reduces costly misroutings and improves automated triage efficiency.

items.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: METTA introduces a memory‑enhanced test‑time adaptation method for meta‑reinforcement learning, improving task evidence representation over long histories.
items.whyItMatters: It offers faster, more efficient adaptation for agents in dynamic environments, appealing to researchers building scalable RL systems.

items.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
items.summary: EpiSEM-Bench tests how LLM agents handle missing safety facts when using tools, measuring unsafe actions and evidence recovery.
items.whyItMatters: It helps ensure AI agents act safely even when tool outputs omit critical safety information.

items.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
items.summary: The article discusses using low-bit n-gram embeddings to reduce memory usage in large language models.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it enables deploying powerful models on limited hardware.

items.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
items.summary: The article identifies two numerical bugs in softmax and cross-entropy implementations that distort gradients during training.
items.whyItMatters: Fixing these bugs improves model convergence and training stability for AI practitioners.

items.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
items.summary: The paper examines how chain-of-thought prompting can lead to attention leakage, proposing context isolation to ensure reasoning steps causally influence the answer.
items.whyItMatters: It improves reliability of AI explanations, crucial for trustworthy decision-making.

items.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
items.summary: The paper demonstrates using an LLM-powered agent to debug a multilingual web corpus by generating testable findings for each language.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it improves data quality for multilingual AI models with automated, scalable auditing.

items.title: Bilingual Language Models Capture Cross-Linguistic Influence in Second-Language Reading
items.summary: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1). items.title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.summary: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. items.title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
items.summary: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs.
